transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, September 3. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Rohit's future, ODI roadmap to 2027 World Cup and recent setbacks on agenda at BCCI meeting. Stalwart's career, ODI team and the team's poor performances in Ireland and England to be discussed as Indian cricket's top brass meets on September 3 in Mumbai. Months after Dell's $6.25B pledge, Trump Accounts get new rules. The new guidance from the US Treasury simplifies payroll contributions for child savings accounts, allowing employers to contribute up to $2,500 annually for employee dependents, free from taxes. Employees can also make pre-tax contributions directly. This initiative is backed by a generous $6.25 billion commitment from the Michael and Susan Dell Foundation, with more than fifty companies already on board. 11 coaches in 5 years: Inside Pak cricket's never-ending coaching carousel. Pakistan cricket has struggled with ongoing coaching instability, marked by numerous changes and management reshuffles since September 2021. The Pakistan Cricket Board has tried various structures and roles for senior management, leading to short-lived appointments of prominent figures like Jason Gillespie and Gary Kirsten. This unpredictable pattern underscores a long-standing challenge within the sport, raising questions about the team's direction and consistency. Government defends GDP data after ex-FS claims Q1 growth 2.6 percent. NEW DELHI: Government on Wednesday strongly defended the sanctity of GDP data, and argued its critics' arguments are flawed. Russia largest supplier of crude in Aug, US tops LPG, LNG volumes. NEW DELHI: Russia remained the largest supplier of crude to India in Aug, while US supplied highest volumes of LPG and LNG, data from maritime intelligence and research firm Kpler shows. 2 killed, multiple injured in Minneapolis apartment shooting. At least two people were killed and six others were left injured in a shooting at an apartment building in downtown Minneapolis, according to officials. SC: BCI chair's tenure is for 2 years, can't be made 5 years by own resolution. 'Lavish spending', P 10 12-year-old Staten Island boy sells drinks to fund backpack giveaway for kids. Meet 12-year-old Staten Island student Tamir Lewis, who has turned his entrepreneurial spirit into a community initiative. Known for selling drinks and ices at local basketball games, Tamir is now organising a backpack giveaway to help children prepare for the new school year, with donated backpacks, school supplies, food and community support making the event possible. Op Sindoor commander Jeetendra Mishra selected as Ayodhya Ram temple's first CEO. LUCKNOW: Sixteen months after playing a key role in Operation Sindoor, the officer who commanded India's western air operations has been chosen for a very different assignment. Gavin Newsom lists 8-acre Fair Oaks estate for $7.5m, double 2018 price. California Governor Gavin Newsom has listed his sprawling Fair Oaks mansion for $7.5 million, nearly double the $3.7 million he paid in 2018. The 8.2-acre estate features seven bedrooms, 12 bathrooms and luxury amenities including a swimming pool, full-size tennis court, cold plunge, hot tub and a 5,000-bottle wine cellar. SpaceX sends $4.3bn Roman Space Telescope to look for 'weird, rare' stars, planets. SpaceX has achieved another milestone by successfully launching NASA's Roman Space Telescope into orbit. This groundbreaking observatory is designed to delve into the mysteries of distant planets and the enigmatic forces of dark energy. Its expansive field of view is one hundred times that of the Hubble Space Telescope, enabling it to work in tandem with other instruments, paving the way for extraordinary cosmic discoveries awaiting our exploration.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Mahakal Lok To Glow With Thousands Of Diyas On PM Modi's Birthday; MP Plans Month-Long Campaign. Ujjain's Mahakal Lok will be illuminated with a large number of earthen lamps on Prime Minister Narendra Modi's birthday on September 17, Chief Minister Mohan Yadav said. Bhopal's Kolar Shuts Down As 800 Traders Hit Streets, Stage Mock Funeral Against BMC Sealing Drive. Nearly 700-800 traders shut shops across a 10-km stretch of Bhopal's Kolar and staged a mock funeral of their businesses to protest BMC's sealing drive. From MP's Sagar Village To Viral Fame: Visually Impaired Singer Sunil Lodhi Wins Millions Of Hearts. Visually impaired singer Sunil Lodhi from MP's Sagar has become an Internet sensation with his devotional track 'Maine Tere Hi Bharose Hanuman' from 'Hanuman Ansh'. MP Private Schools Await rupees 800 Crore RTE Dues For 2 Years; Financial Pressure Mounts. Private schools across Madhya Pradesh are awaiting around rupees 800 crore in RTE fee reimbursements for the 2024-25 and 2025-26 academic years. Indore News: Women Must Be Self-Reliant, Says Dr Sandhya Vyas. Sub-inspector Shivam Thakkar spoke about cybercrime awareness, advising citizens not to share personal information on social media and to report suspicious incidents to the cyber cell. 4 Madhya Pradesh boys from a family die within 10 days after waterfall visit. No Money For Hotel Bill, But Claimed To Be IAS: 'Fake Collector' Held In Indore. Indore's Lasudiya police arrested 28-year-old Himanshu Panchal for allegedly posing as an IAS officer and district collector. IMD predicts very heavy rainfall over East Madhya Pradesh. Death sentence commuted to 25 years of jail. Bhopal civic body to shut down 130 commercial properties in residential areas. Food Safety Alert In Indore: Hotel Sayaji Samples, 17 Ghee Samples Found Unsafe. Food Safety Administration reports in Indore found two of eight samples from Hotel Sayaji unsafe and three below prescribed standards. Disaster Management Teams Activated In Bhopal After Journalists Learned From BMC To Get Information In One Click. Bulldozers Roll In Indore's Musakhedi; 17 Structures Removed For 45-Metre-Wide Road. Indore Municipal Corporation removed more than 17 houses and shops obstructing the proposed 45-metre-wide Musakhedi Square-Sanwariya Dham Temple road after property owners allegedly failed to act on notices. Madhya Pradesh: 5 dead, 20 injured in bus-bulker crash; PM Modi offers condolences. 'State must be a model litigant': Madhya Pradesh ordered to pay rupees 78 lakh to senior advocate. Madhya Pradesh: Missing For 12 Days, Kuno Cheetah Nirva Located After Collar Glitch. Daily Court Digest: Major environment orders (September 1, 2026). Bhopal–Dewas Road to get barrier-free tolling: Vehicles can pass at 100 km/h without stopping; no boom barr.

transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Nifty stages recovery from lows; Can bulls push the index back above 24,000?. Gold Holds Gain as Trump's War Comments Ease Inflation Jitters. Gold held a gain as US President Donald Trump appeared to rule out prolonged military action in the Middle East, easing inflationary concerns driven by a renewed spike in energy prices. Mutual funds and equities accounted for 15 per cent of household financial savings in FY25, while mutual fund assets rose to 31 per cent of bank deposits in 2025 Dollar Debasement Is Favoring Singapore's Currency, Analysts Say. The Singapore dollar is tracking the US currency in an inverse direction more closely than any other in Asia, which analysts say positions it for stronger gains in the region if the "dollar debasement trade" gathers pace. INR edges lower in tight moves; weighed down by higher oil prices, weaker dollar and muted equities. The Indian rupee traded in a tight range and settled for the day at 94.97 (provisional) on Wednesday, recording a marginal loss of 2 paise as the support from foreign capital inflows was negated by weak local equities and a strong US dollar. Brent crude prices have risen to USD 95 per barrel and the dollar index is hovering around 99.80 on a bout of risk aversion on renewed US-Iran tensions. Moreover, market participants have raised the probability of a hike in interest rates by the US Federal Reserve in September, pushing US Treasury yields higher and triggering a broad dollar rally. Indian shares fell notably on Wednesday to extend recent losses amid hawkish Federal Reserve expectations and escalating Middle East tensions. Reliance Consumer Products has entered Indias ice-cream market with Bombay Creamery, pricing cups, cones and sticks from rupees 10. GLOBAL-PRECIOUS:Gold rebounds over 1 percent as US dollar, yields pull back from highs Sensex, Nifty extend losses as Middle East tensions lift oil, yields. Key equity indices came under broad-based selling pressure on Wednesday as escalating US-Iran tensions drove crude oil prices higher and heightened concerns over inflation, interest rates and economic growth. The Nifty ended below the 23,950 mark, led by auto and IT shares, while oil and gas stocks gained. The broader market also weakened, with midcap and smallcap indices falling over 0.5 percent each. Brent crude crossed $95 a barrel, while higher global bond yields added to pressure on equities. India-US ties are at historic high point: Sergio Gor. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Insurers plan floor for fire cover to avoid large burns. Non-life insurers are considering a minimum rate for fire insurance's natural catastrophe component. This move follows concerns about steep discounts exposing the industry and reinsurers to losses. The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India chairman also expressed worries about insurer financial health. Aggressive pricing and recent fire losses in Gujarat have fueled these discussions. Mid caps hit a new high in August 2026, while large caps remain below peaks: What investors should know. August 2026 saw a clear divergence across market-cap segments. Midcaps and smallcaps gained while largecaps declined. Midcaps also hit a new peak, while smallcaps came close. Over 10 years long period, midcaps delivered the highest returns. SBI customer alert: UPI services to remain unavailable for 45 minutes on September 4; check timings. State Bank of India UPI services will be unavailable for a short duration this week. Customers should note the scheduled maintenance period for UPI payments. This interruption is planned for September 4, 2026. SBI suggests using UPI Lite services for uninterrupted transactions during this time. CGHS rules changed: Critical illness can now mean lifetime benefits for dependent sons, brothers. CGHS rules have been relaxed for dependent sons and brothers with critical or terminal illnesses, allowing eligible beneficiaries to receive medical benefits for life. EPFO services you can still avail on its portal: Tracking application status, filing death claim, UAN allotment and more. The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation has revamped its services for members, allowing UAN activation solely through the UMANG app, utilizing advanced face authentication. While members can track pension applications and file death claims via the EPFO portal, UAN allotment and retrieval services continue to be accessible on the EPFO website. 8th Pay Commission: Key dates and updates to watch as government employees and pensioners await July DA hike. Government employees and pensioners await the July 2026 Dearness Allowance revision and the 8th Pay Commission consultations. Meetings are ongoing to discuss pay and pension matters, with recommendations expected by mid-2027. Unlimited airport lounge access for 1 year: Paisabazaar launches limited-period PB Pass offer. All consumers who take a new credit card through the Paisabazaar platform during the offer period (until the end of September) would be eligible for a PB Pass. The complimentary pass gets unlocked when these customers make their first payment of the credit card through the Paisabazaar app. Gold loans surge 4x in the last 5 years, but penetration remains low: Report reveals where the growth is coming from. India's gold loan market has nearly quadrupled to rupees 18.6 trillion in five years, overtaking personal loans. Yet, only around 8 percent of household gold is monetised through organised lenders. Find who is borrowing, which states are driving growth, and which lenders are gaining share. Read to know what happened in this case. SBI user alert: UPI outage scheduled for September 4; what you need to know. Investment strategies should adapt as goals approach, particularly between three to five years. Moving away from high-risk equity is essential for protecting savings. Big CGHS relief for families: Lifelong medical cover for married dependent sons, brothers with critical illnesses. In a significant update, the CGHS and CS(MA) Rules now offer lifelong medical support to dependent sons and brothers, ensuring marriage does not affect their eligibility for CGHS benefits. Dependency criteria and medical board evaluations are essential for qualification, particularly for chronic and severe medical conditions that affect one's earning capacity. The CGHS Board will routinely reassess the medical requirements to keep provisions current. GIFT City funds: How retail investors can access global markets as international schemes face curbs. GIFT City offers Indian retail investors an alternative route to global equity exposure as overseas investment limits constrain domestic mutual funds. Here's how the route works, available fund options, LRS rules, SIP limitations, accessible markets, costs, and tax implications. Neighbour tried to grab land using a rectification deed without owner's consent: Here's why Supreme Court offered relief to owner. Neighbour tried to take land using rectification deed without informing owner; Supreme Court says rectification deed cannot change title of property which is covered by sale deed. Read below to know why Mr Thimmadasappa's son won the case in Supreme Court. Taking a rupees 1 crore home loan? You could pay another rupees 1 crore in interest: Here's how to cut your interest burden. To reduce interest on loans, consider early principal reduction for guaranteed returns. Shortening loan tenure can lower overall interest even with higher EMIs. Focus on total repayment rather than just EMIs to better manage loan costs. SIF minimum investment rule: How is the rupees 10 lakh threshold calculated for an investor? Experts weigh in. SIFs have a rupees 10 lakh minimum investment requirement, but investors need not put the entire amount in one strategy. The threshold is calculated across SIF strategies of the same AMC at the PAN level. Here's how SIP, SWP, STP, exemptions and breaches work. Banks slash FCNR (B) interest rates: HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, SBI, PNB, Axis Bank revise rates on 3-5-year deposits. FCNR (B) deposit interest rate cuts have particularly been made in deposits of three to five years, which had higher interest rates after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced a relief on hedging costs.
